Artist

The
Artist

Go Freek is Caleb Crinis, an Australian electronic producer and DJ based in Germany. His music sits where house, electro and left-field club pressure meet, filtered through a sound he calls Gutter Tech: physical drums, distorted low end, sharp hooks and strange details that survive outside the club as well as inside it. His catalogue includes the ARIA Gold Dom Dolla collaboration Define, which topped the ARIA Club Chart for three consecutive weeks. The current chapter is built around new music, selective live proof and a more authored Go Freek world.
